common_prompt: Create ONE 16:9 photorealistic-natural WHAT IT COST documentary photographic asset, not a collage, graphic-design slide or poster. Match supplied original VIDEO008 photographic bases in contemporary materials, restrained neutral practical light, charcoal pebbled desk, clean ivory paper and black stationery. References are style/physical composition ONLY: never copy their company text, numbers, transactions or old case. Deliberately distinct shot scale and document arrangement for this specific scene. Everything photographed in one real physical setting. Small supporting ORIGINAL EDITORIAL WORKING NOTES, not official/company documents and not purported historical evidence. Print only the explicitly requested non-numeric analytical labels and notes, black ink, restrained normal serif. No invented prose, pseudo-writing, letterheads, seals, signatures, bank forms, case numbers, quotes, dates or monetary values. Real official sources and exact critical figures will be separate unchanged source/Fusion layers, never redraw them. No giant EDITORIAL ANALYSIS title, no generic A4 worksheet filling the screen. Compose filled concise paper objects with deliberate physical hierarchy, 2-3 modest edge props, tactile irregularity but no antique parchment. Top 18-25% is quiet charcoal for separate editable headline/figure layers. Bottom 20% contains no important writing. NO colored outlines, red/yellow accents, rectangles, arrows, underlines, highlights, source/provenance banners, glowing lines, counters, mechanisms, 3D diagrams, gold/marble, fake issued tickets or identification. No humans, faces, identifiable third-party brands. No device UI. Exact numbers/dates and analytical connectors are deliberately absent and will be editable Fusion nodes. Natural photographic restraint, not theatrical film prop styling.

first_jobs.scene: Use the SC010 four-packet composition, but THREE compact unevenly staggered archival packets across the middle 45-75% of frame. Low overhead camera, NOT the giant single-sheet layout. Left packet contains small original editorial note headed 'BOOKING CLAIMS' with two short lines 'Activity represented' and 'Completed transactions?'. Center note 'REVENUE CLAIMS' / 'Income represented' / 'Independent records?'. Right note 'INVESTOR CONFIDENCE' / 'Reliance on representations'. These are editorial questions, no official findings or alleged emails. A slim black folder and simple pencil at opposite frame edges. Separate packets have different widths and exposed paper depths, not identical cards. Quiet substantial desk above, dark foreground below, no connecting arrows or banners.

Use the SC040 layered-wide-source composition in a CLOSE OBLIQUE DETAIL, camera lower and closer than the reference. Two narrow, wide ORIGINAL EDITORIAL research slips at different depths across a partly opened black folio, neither a full A4 sheet. Upper slip reads 'CLAIMED HOLDINGS' then 'Statement presented to investors'; lower slip reads 'VERIFIED HOLDINGS' then 'Underlying share ownership and market value'. No dollar values, no invented brokerage table, no official document. Leave ordinary negative space above each slip for separately composited exact values. Small closed calculator corner at far right, one binder clip near upper left, no coffee. Natural compressed paper layers and realistic black folio texture. Bottom fifth dark and unobstructed.
